visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens on a snowy, forested ski slope under overcast skies. A man in a blue winter jacket and a child in a dark grey snowsuit stand on snowboards; the child begins a slow descent while the man observes. A small circular inset in the top right shows a man's face in a black beanie. (2) The camera follows the child as they successfully navigate a turn on the slope. Bare, snow-covered trees line the background. White text overlays appear following the child's movement. (3) A shot change shows the child farther down the slope, demonstrating improved speed and balance while another skier in purple passes in the distance. (4) A close-up reveals a woman in a grey snow jacket and blue-tinted goggles sitting in the snow, struggling with her snowboard. She attempts to stand while adjusting her bindings under the guidance of the man in the blue jacket. (5) The woman successfully stands up and begins her descent, filmed from a low angle behind her. The camera follows her as she gains momentum. (6) The final phase shows the woman gliding down the wide slope, with other skiers visible in the far background near a small wooden building, while celebratory text overlays fill the screen.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: The main coach is a man in a blue hooded ski jacket; the female student wears a grey snow jacket, a black helmet, and blue-mirrored goggles.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A snowy ski slope surrounded by dense, bare deciduous trees covered in snow under a grey, flat sky.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Upbeat acoustic guitar pop music with male English vocals plays throughout. A male voice enthusiastically cheers 'Shui!' (meaning 'Great') with high pitch variability as the sound of snowboards cutting through snow creates a soft, white-noise floor. (2) The male voice continues with rhythmic encouragement, 'Zhuan hui lai, dui!', maintaining high vocal arousal. The music tempo remains steady at around 115 BPM with a clear rhythmic backbeat. (3) A female voice enters briefly, sounding hesitant and low-arousal, saying 'Wo zhan bu qi lai...' (I can't stand up). This is followed immediately by the male voice's supportive, firm, and friendly tone: 'Ni ke yi de'. (4) The male coach's voice persists with a steady stream of positive reinforcement ('Dui, shui! Hao!') overlapping the melodic BGM and the crisp, percussive sound of snowboard edges engaging with packed snow. (5) The video ends with a series of quick 'Shui wo' cheers from the male voice, perfectly synchronized with the woman successfully gliding away, while the BGM maintains its bright, major-key energy.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote the positive and encouraging coaching style of 'Coach Andy' by showing successful moments with a child and a beginning adult student on a ski slope.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Prominent display of the 'ISKI' logo on the coach's jacket and the textual reference to 'Coach Andy'.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses high-arousal audio and supportive text overlays to create a motivational atmosphere for potential skiing/snowboarding students.
